name: grain-gradient
title: Grain gradient
description: A mesh gradient drifts under film grain. It loops with no join at whole-number speeds.

props.name: palette
props.doc: Colours of the mesh, spread over its points in a fixed pattern. Two to eight.

props.name: speed
props.doc: How fast the field drifts. Whole numbers loop seamlessly over 10 seconds.

props.name: scale
props.doc: How far the points wander, as a multiple of the default. 1 is about a tenth of a cell.

props.name: softness
props.doc: Blur over the mesh in pixels: higher is smoother, lower shows more of the patches.

props.name: grain
props.doc: Grain amount. 0.1 is a visible film grain.

props.name: grainSize
props.doc: Size of a grain cell in pixels.
